headline: Off the shelf (squidpy + lifelines, 8 cores): 24.44 s/study MEASURED, instrumented workflow, includes our reference recount and agreement (one study per worker: median 170 s, range 161-183 s; off the shelf only 21.4 s/study, DERIVED: worker time / 8, assumes perfect utilisation); 27.7x the hand-written lab arm (0.8809 s) and 583x the fused path (0.0419 s), cross-run, same container class: the lab (0.8809 s, #113) and fused (0.0419 s, #120) times come from other runs on other hosts of this class, not this container; what a lab would run off the shelf, not Preflight's speedup: squidpy's enrichment z is a permutation z-score and lifelines fits a Wald Cox per feature, different statistics from our enrichment ratio and stratified Cox score z (see agreement_median)
method:
External baseline: the design point done the way a lab would with off-the-shelf tools (squidpy + lifelines).

Per study, from the same design, seeds and draws as #113 (bench/design_batch.py):
  cells     the visible, mis-called cells our re-imager sees (core.reimage_ref.draw, crop_mask, miscall), so both
            pipelines get the same cells; study_cells() is checked bit for bit against core.reimage_ref.reimage.
  squidpy   per drawn patient, one AnnData of its regions; per radius (25, 50, 100 um)
            sq.gr.spatial_neighbors(coord_type="generic", radius=r, library_key="region") and
            sq.gr.nhood_enrichment (default 1,000 permutations). It fills the same 630 slots as our grammar,
            (tumour type t, neighbour type j, radius, statistic): "fraction" = squidpy's edge count share
            count[t, j] / sum_j count[t, :], "enrichment" = its z-score. NaN where the patient has no visible t.
  lifelines CoxPHFitter per feature, strata = coverslip group, rows with NaN dropped; Bonferroni over all 630:
            the study is called when min p x 630 <= 0.05.
Timed per study inside one single-thread pool worker: draw, mis-call, AnnData, squidpy and lifelines. Our own X and
score z on the same cells are computed after the timer, for agreement only. Seconds per study = pool wall / N,
the basis of the fused path's 0.0419 s (#120: compute_wall_s / 3,000 studies, 8 workers).

lab.basis: lab compute_wall_s 1,761.88 / 2,000 studies (null and alternative ids 0-999, which include these), 8 single-thread workers (#113)

settings.n_jobs_note: squidpy's documented n_jobs=8 path failed on Modal at 2955a9d (bench/results/external-baseline-20261122T045024Z.json): its joblib workers get read-only memmapped uint32 arrays its numba kernel has no signature for; so all 8 cores go to 8 study workers with n_jobs=1, the lab and fused arms' basis

modal.note: wall_s includes container start and image pull; pool_wall_s is inside the container
